description: MainActivity.kt defines an Android activity that manages a UI button to toggle the device's flashlight (torch). It handles camera permissions, interacts with Camera2 API to control the torch, and updates UI components based on flashlight state.
external_files: R (generated resource class, e.g., R.layout.activity_main, R.id.toggleButton, R.string.*)

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity providing UI to toggle device flashlight, managing camera permissions, and interacting with Camera2 API to control flashlight state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI, camera manager, finds back camera with flash, and registers torch callback.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Ensures torch callback registration and updates UI.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Turns off torch safely when activity pauses.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Unregisters torch callback to prevent leaks.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Ensures callbacks are unregistered on cleanup.

methods.name: handleToggleClick
methods.description: Handles user click to toggle flashlight, requesting permissions if needed.

methods.name: requestCameraPermissionIfNeeded
methods.description: Checks and requests camera permission if not granted.

methods.name: retryToggleAfterPermission
methods.description: Attempts to toggle the flashlight again after permission is granted.

methods.name: turnTorchSafe
methods.description: Safely turns torch on or off, catching security exceptions.

methods.name: turnTorchInternal
methods.description: Sets torch mode via CameraManager and updates UI.

methods.name: findBackCameraWithFlash
methods.description: Locates a back-facing camera with flash support.

methods.name: registerTorchCallbackSafe
methods.description: Registers or unregisters TorchCallback with exception handling.

methods.name: updateUi
methods.description: Updates toggle button's enabled state, text, appearance based on torch availability and state.
